map: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a production transparent pixel-art asset atlas for a Korean coastal exploration RPG. Input image1 is a supporting style reference for chunky pixels and warm muted colors; use original Korean vernacular hanok architecture, not generic fantasy castles. Square canvas with EXACTLY 3columns x3rows, nine separate objects. Each cell must contain one full isolated object centered with at least32px empty transparent margin, never touching another cell. Orthographic RPG camera, front facade with roof top visible, no isometric skew. Row1 left: modest HANOK RESEARCH LAB, broad dark blue-grey curved giwa tile roof with simple ridge and subtle eaves, exposed warm wood pillars, ivory plaster walls, blue windows, central wood doorway, small brass telescope set at one roof side. Row1 center: KOREAN GUARDIAN HALL, single-storey wide paljak giwa roof, restrained green/red dancheong under the eaves, wood pillars, stone foundation, central door, a simple small circular two-island emblem; NO giant Chinese golden crest, dragons or upswept pagoda corners. Row1 right: HANOK village shop with dark charcoal giwa roof, wooden beams, ivory walls, short cream linen awning above central door, woven basket and brown onggi jar to side. Row2 left: compact traditional Korean home with curved charcoal giwa roof, exposed wooden frame, cream plaster infill, paper lattice windows, central door and low stone platform. Row2 center: a SINGLE windswept Korean coastal pine with dark green broad layered canopy and sturdy brown trunk, no ground patch. Row2 right: low rough granite stone planter holding pink white and yellow coastal flowers. Row3 left: short horizontal Korean stone wall segment, stacked irregular grey stones, narrow dark giwa tiled cap and small square stone end posts. Row3 center: small cream and wooden Korean coastal fishing/research boat seen from above, bow UP, teal cabin and short mast. Row3 right: freestanding Korean wooden village noticeboard with tiny curved giwa roof, two sturdy posts and blank cream paper, no text. All9 assets form one consistent art set: crisp deliberately chunky square pixel clusters, clear very dark 1pixel outline, low-detail 3shade materials, sage green, charcoal, ivory, russet wood and desaturated blue. Logical resolution buildings roughly96x80, tree48x56, smallprops32x24 enlarged with crisp edges. No blur, painterly shading, gradients, labels, writing, watermarks, background or ground shadows. Genuinely transparent alpha background.
monument: Use case: stylized-concept. A single transparent pixel-art decorative monument for a Korean coastal RPG village, same warm muted chunky pixel style as the attached professor character reference. Sculpture of TWO unequal rugged volcanic rocky islets standing side by side on a low wide rectangular grey granite pedestal, a tiny blank brass plaque inset in its front. This is a fictional decorative monument inspired by Dokdo's East and West islands, not a literal scale map. Taller islet on left, lower rugged islet on right, sparse olive grass atop rocks. Orthographic RPG view slightly from above, front face visible, no isometric angle. Sturdy stepped dark outlines, deliberate coarse square pixels, limited warm-grey stone shades, about64x64logical pixels enlarged. Isolated and fully visible with generous transparent margin, no ground patch, no backdrop, no text, no people, no flag, no gradients, no decorative lanterns or unrelated symbols. Width:height roughly1.15:1. Transparent background.
professor: Use case: stylized-concept. Create production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for Dokdo Explorers RPG. Image 1 is the exact character identity reference: elderly professor with khaki safari hat, dark round glasses, white beard and hair, olive multi-pocket expedition vest, dark brown trousers, brown boots and small olive backpack. Image 2 is supporting style and layout reference, match its chunky readable pixels, thick limbs and black stepped outline. Transparent background, no shadows, no text, no grid. Landscape canvas 1536x1024, EXACTLY 5 columns x 3 rows, 15 isolated full-body poses with generous clear margins. Row1 facing front/down; row2 facing RIGHT; row3 facing back/up. In EVERY row col1 is straight upright standing with feet together, head directly above torso, relaxed arms. Col2 left leg forward/right arm forward; col3 passing stance; col4 right leg forward/left arm forward; col5 opposite passing stance. Side views must visibly alternate near and far leg and arm, natural knees, sturdy boots and thick sleeves, no rubber limbs. Same identity, proportions, apparent size, head height and ground baseline across each row. Flat limited muted olive, tan and warm brown palette, deliberate square pixels, no antialiasing or blur. Preserve hat, glasses, beard, vest and backpack from image1; redraw cleanly for animation.
